## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 5-fascicle text by [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7) Dānapāla is the Northern-Sòng version of the *Kāśyapa-parivarta*, paralleling the earlier [Lokakṣema T0350](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0042) and [anonymous T0351](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0043). The 5-fascicle scope reflects an expanded recension of the underlying Indic text relative to the earlier Chinese versions.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7) Dānapāla's Northern-Sòng imperial-bureau activity (980 – 1017 CE).

The Taishō text (T0352) is established on the standard apparatus.
